# @rxova/react-file-input

> A headless, accessible file picker and drop zone for React: `accept` and size
> rules, deduplication, announced add and remove, and optional image previews
> whose object URLs are revoked for you. It never uploads anything — the value is
> a `File[]` and the transport is yours. Zero dependencies. No stylesheet.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-file-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { FileInput, describeRejection } from '@rxova/react-file-input'

export function Attachments() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([])

  return (
    <FileInput
      label="Attachments"
      name="attachments"
      multiple
      accept=".pdf,image/*"
      maxSize={5_000_000}
      maxFiles={5}
      previews
      value={files}
      onChange={setFiles}
      onReject={(attempt) => {
        console.warn(describeRejection(attempt, { maxSize: 5_000_000 }))
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

`<FileInput>` — the full surface is `FileInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `File[]` | — | Controlled list of files. |
| `defaultValue` | `File[]` | — | Uncontrolled initial list. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(files: File[]) => void` | — | The whole list, after every accepted add or remove. |
| `onAdd` | `(file: File, files: File[]) => void` | — | Once per file actually added, after it passed every rule. |
| `onRemove` | `(file: File, index: number, files: File[]) => void` | — | With the index it occupied. |
| `onReject` | `(attempt: FileRejected) => void` | — | A file that was refused. `reason` is always set: `type`, `too-large`, `too-small`, `duplicate`, `max-files` or `invalid`. |
| `accept` | `string` | — | Exactly as `<input accept>` takes it, and enforced on drop too. |
| `maxSize` | `number` | — | Largest allowed file, in bytes. |
| `minSize` | `number` | — | Smallest allowed file, in bytes. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | — | Maximum number of files. Ignored unless `multiple`. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Like the native input. |
| `dedupe` | `boolean` | `true` | Same name + size + timestamp counts as the same file. |
| `validate` | `(file: File, existing: File[]) => boolean \| string` | — | Final say; a string is the refusal message. |
| `previews` | `boolean` | `false` | Object URLs for image files, revoked on removal and unmount. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the field. **Not rendered** — supply your own `<label htmlFor={`${id}-input`}>` for a visible one, and pass `label` too: it also names the drop zone, the field's one tab stop. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` | a stock sentence | Text inside the drop zone. |
| `removeLabel` | `(file: File) => string` | ``Remove ${name}`` | Accessible name for a file's remove button. |
| `renderFile` | `(state: FileEntryState) => ReactNode` | the default row | Replaces a row's contents; the remove button stays. |
| `announce` | `(event: { type: 'add' \| 'remove' \| 'reject'; files: File[]; added?: number; rejected?: FileRejected[] }) => string` | a stock sentence | Live-region text. Return `''` to say nothing. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Name for the underlying `<input type="file">`. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the selection but refuses changes. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Focuses the drop zone on mount — the visible affordance, not the hidden input. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name when there is no `label`. Wins over `label`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; the input, drop zone, list and live region derive theirs from it. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: FileWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `useFileInput` hook and the pure helpers `attempt`,
`attemptAll`, `matchesAccept`, `describeRejection`, `extensionOf`, `fileKey`,
`formatBytes`, `isPreviewable`.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-file-gap`, `--rx-file-zone-gap`, `--rx-file-zone-padding`, `--rx-file-zone-radius`,
`--rx-file-zone-border`, `--rx-file-zone-background`, `--rx-file-row-gap`, `--rx-file-list-gap`,
`--rx-file-preview-size`, `--rx-file-preview-radius`, `--rx-file-remove-size`.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-file-root`, `data-rx-file-input`, `data-rx-file-zone`, `data-rx-file-list`,
`data-rx-file-file`, `data-rx-file-name`, `data-rx-file-size`, `data-rx-file-preview`,
`data-rx-file-remove`, `data-rx-file-announcement`, plus the state hooks `data-dragging`,
`data-count`, `data-full`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-invalid`.

## Three mistakes to avoid

1. **Expecting an upload.** Nothing leaves the page. You get `File` objects and
   send them yourself — `FormData`, a signed URL, whatever the backend wants —
   which is why there is no progress bar or retry policy to configure.
2. **Calling `URL.createObjectURL` yourself when `previews` is on.** Each
   `FileEntry` already carries a `preview` URL, created lazily and revoked when
   the file is removed or the component unmounts. A second URL for the same file
   is the leak `previews` exists to avoid.
3. **Trusting `accept` as validation.** It filters the picker and the drop, both
   client-side, on a filename extension or a browser-reported MIME type. Check
   the bytes on the server; this is a usability filter, not a security control.
